commands.name: New
commands.description: Start a new, empty project

commands.name: Open...
commands.description: Open a saved project

commands.name: Save
commands.description: Save the project

commands.name: Save As...
commands.description: Save the project under a new name

commands.name: Consolidate Project...
commands.description: Copy every audio file the project uses into its folder (Audio Files), so it's all in one place

commands.name: Save as Template...
commands.description: Save this project as a template to start new ones from (File > New from Template)

commands.name: New Alternative...
commands.description: Save a copy of the project beside it, to try ideas and switch between them (File > Alternatives)

commands.name: Revert to Backup...
commands.description: Open one of the backups made each time you saved

commands.name: Import Audio File...
commands.description: Put audio files on the selected track at the playhead

commands.name: Bounce Song to WAV...
commands.description: Export the song, or the cycle range, to a WAV file

commands.name: Export All Tracks as Audio Files...
commands.description: Each track (and bus) to its own WAV in a folder, with its plugins, fader and pan, ignoring solo

commands.name: Import Tracks from Project...
commands.description: Bring tracks (regions, plugins, sends, automation) in from another project

commands.name: Show Inserts in Edit Window
commands.description: Each track's insert slots beside its header (as in Pro Tools' Edit window)

commands.name: Show I/O in Edit Window
commands.description: Each track's input and output beside its header, to choose them there (as on the mixer strips)

commands.name: Exclusive Solo
commands.description: Soloing a track unsolos the others (as in LUNA)

commands.name: MultiMeter
commands.description: The master's meters: levels, loudness (LUFS), spectrum, goniometer and phase correlation

commands.name: Automix...
commands.description: A balanced starting mix for a genre: each track measured and its fader set (one undo step)

commands.name: Show Comments in Mixer
commands.description: A notes field under each mixer channel (as in Pro Tools)

commands.name: Open Project from Another Program...
commands.description: Open an Ableton Live, FL Studio, Studio One, Pro Tools, Logic, Cubase, DAWproject or MIDI file project

commands.name: Bounce in Place
commands.description: Render the selected track to a new audio track and mute the original

commands.name: Undo
commands.description: Undo the last edit

commands.name: Redo
commands.description: Redo the edit you undid

commands.name: Delete
commands.description: Delete the selected region

commands.name: Split at Playhead
commands.description: Split regions at the playhead

commands.name: Quantize
commands.description: Quantize the selected MIDI region to 16th notes

commands.name: Set Locators by Selection
commands.description: Set the cycle to the selected region and turn Cycle on

commands.name: Cut
commands.description: Cut the selected regions

commands.name: Copy
commands.description: Copy the selected regions

commands.name: Paste
commands.description: Paste at the playhead, on the selected track

commands.name: Select All
commands.description: Select every region

commands.name: Repeat
commands.description: Repeat the selected regions once, right after them

commands.name: Join Regions
commands.description: Join the selected regions on a track into one (audio: consolidated into one new file)

commands.name: Consolidate Clips
commands.description: The selected audio regions on each track become one region playing one new file (gain, fades and transpose in it; gaps silent)

commands.name: Align Audio to Guide...
commands.description: Lines the timing of the selected regions up with a guide region (the top one), as VocAlign and Cubase's AudioAlign do

commands.name: Save a Copy As...
commands.description: A copy of the project with every audio file it uses, in one folder (and a .zip to send if you like): it opens on any computer

commands.name: Close Project
commands.description: Closes the project (asking to save changes first)

commands.name: Find Missing Audio Files...
commands.description: Looks for audio files the project can't find, in a folder you choose

commands.name: Detect Song Key...
commands.description: Listens to the song (or the selected regions) and finds its key and scale, to set as the project's key

commands.name: Split to Stems...
commands.description: Splits the selected audio regions into vocals, drums, bass and the rest (or six stems, with guitar and piano), each on a new track, as Logic's Stem Splitter does

commands.name: Mute Regions
commands.description: Mute or unmute the selected regions

commands.name: Nudge Left
commands.description: Move the selected regions a 16th note earlier

commands.name: Nudge Right
commands.description: Move the selected regions a 16th note later

commands.name: Trim Region Start to Playhead
commands.description: Move the selected regions' start to the playhead

commands.name: Trim Region End to Playhead
commands.description: Move the selected regions' end to the playhead

commands.name: Loop Regions
commands.description: Repeat the selected regions up to the next region (drag the upper right edge to set how far)

commands.name: Region Gain...
commands.description: Turn the selected audio regions up or down

commands.name: Remove Fades
commands.description: Take the fades off the selected regions

commands.name: Split Regions by Locators
commands.description: Split every region at the cycle's start and end

commands.name: Cut Section Between Locators
commands.description: Remove the cycle's stretch of the song, and close the gap

commands.name: Insert Silence Between Locators
commands.description: Open a gap the length of the cycle at its start

commands.name: Repeat Section Between Locators
commands.description: Play the cycle's stretch twice: a copy right after it

commands.name: Tool Menu
commands.description: Choose a tool: pointer, pencil, eraser, scissors, glue, mute

commands.name: New Audio Track
commands.description: Add an audio track

commands.name: New Software Instrument Track
commands.description: Add an instrument (MIDI) track

commands.name: New Aux Bus
commands.description: Add an aux bus for sends

commands.name: Delete Track
commands.description: Delete the selected track

commands.name: Mute Track
commands.description: Mute or unmute the selected track

commands.name: Solo Track
commands.description: Solo or unsolo the selected track

commands.name: Record Enable Track
commands.description: Arm or disarm the selected track for recording

commands.name: Show Automation
commands.description: Show or hide automation on the selected track

commands.name: Select Previous Track
commands.description: Select the track above

commands.name: Select Next Track
commands.description: Select the track below

commands.name: Hide Track
commands.description: Hide the selected tracks and select the next one (they still play)

commands.name: Show Hidden Tracks
commands.description: Show or leave out the tracks you hid

commands.name: New Track With Duplicate Settings
commands.description: A new track like the selected one (instrument, fader, console, inserts, sends), without its regions

commands.name: Track Colours...
commands.description: Choose a colour for the selected tracks

commands.name: New Drummer Track
commands.description: A drummer who plays the song in a genre: set how busy and how loud, fills and swing

commands.name: New Bass Player Track
commands.description: A session bass player, in the song's key

commands.name: Open Mixer Window
commands.description: The mixer in a window of its own (resize it, put it on another screen)

commands.name: Open Editor Window
commands.description: The piano roll (and the other region editors) in a window of its own

commands.name: Theme...
commands.description: The skin (studio grey or flat dark) and its colours: hue, lightness, contrast, text, accent, meters, grid

commands.name: AudioSuite...
commands.description: Process the selected audio regions offline with an effect or plugin (VST3, AU, CLAP), into new files

commands.name: Performance...
commands.description: How hard the computer works: audio load, its peak, overloads, the disk, and the heaviest tracks

commands.name: Notepad
commands.description: Project notes: lyrics, ideas, what to fix (saved with the project)

commands.name: Browser
commands.description: Find audio files on your computer and put them on the selected track

commands.name: Quick Help
commands.description: A box that explains whatever is under the mouse

commands.name: Waveform Zoom
commands.description: Draw the waveforms taller, to see quiet parts (click again for more, then back)

commands.name: Zoom to Fit
commands.description: The whole song across the tracks area, and every track fitting the height

commands.name: Show Control Bar
commands.description: The bar along the top (display, transport, tools): show or hide it

commands.name: Show Toolbar
commands.description: A row of keys for the common edits (split, join, repeat, quantize, bounce, freeze...)

commands.name: Show Status Bar
commands.description: The line of hints along the bottom

commands.name: Draw with the Graphics Card
commands.description: The window is drawn by the graphics card (smooth meters and scrolling with many tracks) instead of the processor

commands.name: Show Input and Output Meters
commands.description: The meters to the right of the tracks

commands.name: Show Track Headers
commands.description: The track names, buttons and faders at the left of the tracks

commands.name: Show All Panels
commands.description: Inspector, control bar, toolbar, Smart Controls, meters and the status bar

commands.name: Hide All Panels
commands.description: Just the tracks: every panel around them hidden

commands.name: Live Loops
commands.description: A grid of loops per track: start and stop cells and scenes in time, on the next bar

commands.name: New Keyboard Player Track
commands.description: A session keyboard player playing chords in the song's key

commands.name: Create Track Stack...
commands.description: Put the selected tracks in a stack: a folder stack (one fader on top of theirs) or a summing stack (they play into a bus)

commands.name: Create Folder Stack
commands.description: Put the selected tracks in a folder stack: one fader, mute and solo for them all

commands.name: Create Summing Stack
commands.description: Put the selected tracks in a summing stack: they play into one aux bus

commands.name: Freeze Track
commands.description: Render the selected tracks with their instrument and plugins to audio, to save processing (again to unfreeze)

commands.name: New VCA
commands.description: A VCA fader for the selected tracks: it moves them all, keeping their balance

commands.name: Generate MIDI...
commands.description: Write drums, bass, chords and a melody in a genre's style

commands.name: Play or Stop
commands.description: Start or stop playback

commands.name: Record
commands.description: Record on armed tracks, or punch out

commands.name: Go to Beginning
commands.description: Move the playhead to the start

commands.name: Rewind One Bar
commands.description: Move the playhead back one bar

commands.name: Forward One Bar
commands.description: Move the playhead forward one bar

commands.name: Create Marker
commands.description: A marker at the playhead (double-click the marker track for one anywhere)

commands.name: Go to Next Marker
commands.description: Move the playhead to the next marker

commands.name: Go to Previous Marker
commands.description: Move the playhead to the previous marker

commands.name: Delete Marker
commands.description: Delete the selected marker

commands.name: Cycle
commands.description: Turn Cycle (loop) on or off

commands.name: Metronome
commands.description: Turn the click on or off

commands.name: Count-in
commands.description: One bar of click before recording

commands.name: Autopunch
commands.description: Record only between the punch locators (the red bar under the cycle; drag it in the ruler)

commands.name: Snap to Grid
commands.description: Snap on or off: regions and notes land on the grid, or anywhere (Cmd while dragging does the opposite once)

commands.name: Catch Playhead
commands.description: The tracks area follows the playhead while it plays (Logic's Catch); off, the view stays where you put it

commands.name: Bypass All (Compare)
commands.description: Hear the mix with every channel's processing bypassed - preamps, channel strips, inserts, tape - and the master's inserts, bus compressor and tape; again to hear it all back (as one switch, to compare)

commands.name: Reset Channels...
commands.description: Every channel (or the selected ones) and the master back to a fresh start: faders, pans, mute and solo, the channel strips, inserts and sends (as Cubase's Reset MixConsole Channels)

commands.name: Eco Mode
commands.description: For slower computers or a laptop on battery: meters and the playhead drawn 15 times a second instead of 30, still while the app isn't in front, strips out of view left alone - the sound is the same (Settings has On when on battery, too)

commands.name: Suspend Plug-ins When Silent
commands.description: Plug-ins on a track that's silent stop working until sound comes again, to save CPU (as Cubase's VST3 suspend and FL Studio's Smart Disable)

commands.name: Stop Recording on Clip
commands.description: Recording stops by itself if a mic or instrument input clips (hits 0 dB); the take keeps what came before

commands.name: Replace
commands.description: A recording replaces the parts of regions it covers

commands.name: Merge MIDI Recordings
commands.description: MIDI recorded over a MIDI region is merged into it

commands.name: Mixer
commands.description: Show or hide the mixer

commands.name: Piano Roll
commands.description: Open the selected MIDI region in the piano roll, or close it

commands.name: Zoom In
commands.description: Zoom in horizontally

commands.name: Zoom Out
commands.description: Zoom out horizontally

commands.name: Inspector
commands.description: Show or hide the Inspector: the selected track's channel strip and the master's, on the left

commands.name: Zoom Vertical In
commands.description: Make every track taller

commands.name: Zoom Vertical Out
commands.description: Make every track shorter

commands.name: Undo History...
commands.description: Every edit you can undo; click one to go back (or forward) to it

commands.name: Settings...
commands.description: Autosave, backups, recording format and more

commands.name: Smart Controls
commands.description: Eight knobs for the selected track's sound (right-click one to map it)

commands.name: Library
commands.description: Patches: save a track's sound and put it on other tracks

commands.name: Loop Browser
commands.description: Browse a folder of loops and samples: click to hear, drag onto a track

commands.name: Group Settings...
commands.description: Name the groups and choose what each links: volume, mute, solo, record

commands.name: I/O Labels...
commands.description: Your own names for the interface's inputs (they show in the input menus)

commands.name: Signal Flow
commands.description: The selected track's path from its input to the main output, with every stage

commands.name: Controller Assignments...
commands.description: The knobs and faders on your MIDI controller that move tracks (right-click a track > Learn MIDI Controller to add one)

commands.name: Event List
commands.description: The selected MIDI region's notes and controllers as a list you can edit

commands.name: Key Commands...
commands.description: Show and edit the key commands

commands.name: Audio Settings...
commands.description: Choose the audio interface, sample rate and buffer size

commands.name: Calibrate Recording Latency...
commands.description: Measure the round trip of your interface

commands.name: Plug-in Manager...
commands.description: Scan for VST3 and Audio Unit plugins

commands.name: Combine Audio Interfaces...
commands.description: Use several audio interfaces at once, as one

commands.name: Record Screen...
commands.description: Record the app (or the whole screen) to a video with the mix's sound; again to stop

commands.name: Claude Assistant
commands.description: Show or hide the Claude panel: ask questions, or tell it what to do

nemixPresets.name: Grand Piano
nemixPresets.genres: Pop, R&B, Gospel, Jazz, Cinematic, Orchestral

nemixPresets.name: Nylon Guitar
nemixPresets.genres: Latin, Pop, Jazz, Bossa Nova, Reggaeton
